steps.title: 🤝 Collaborate with your team
steps.description:
Invite teammates with the right level of access:

• Viewer — can see configs and audit log, can't change anything
• Editor — can create/edit configs, segments, targeting rules
• Admin — full control: manage environments, API keys, team, webhooks

Use case: Give your product manager 'viewer' access to check feature flags, and your backend engineer 'editor' to manage configs.

steps.title: Open Team settings
steps.description: Add members by email. They'll get an invite to join this project.
